title: Migration Mapping Configuration
description: Defines how old website URLs map to new website structure, including clustering control

migration_date.description: Date when this migration mapping was created

old_url.description: Original URL from old website (can be full URL or relative path). Supports patterns like /path/[slug]

new_path.description: New path in modern website structure

action.description: What to do with this URL: keep (preserve), redirect (301/302), merge (combine with other content), delete (archive)

priority.description: Priority when multiple patterns match (higher = processed first)

standalone.description: If true, this page will NOT be clustered with similar pages during automatic grouping

excludeFromClustering.description: Alias for 'standalone' - exclude from automatic clustering

description.description: Human-readable explanation of this mapping rule

content_migrated.description: Has the content been migrated to the new site?

old_url_pattern.description: Regular expression pattern for matching multiple URLs (advanced usage)

new_path_template.description: Template for new path with capture group placeholders {1}, {2}, etc.

use_regex.description: If true, use old_url_pattern as regex instead of old_url
